verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships an API Key plugin explicitly for authenticating/authorizing machine requests without a human, plus a JWT plugin (JWT + JWKS) and a Device Authorization (RFC 8628) plugin, all of which support service/agent-style authentication flows. However, no evidence explicitly documents an OAuth2 client-credentials grant type or a dedicated 'M2M app registration' concept as named in the story. Missing for 10: explicit client_credentials grant support, service-account/app registration docs, and independent confirmation of machine-to-machine usage in production.
